name: List OS Information
command:
uname -a >> "#{output_file}"
if [ -f /etc/lsb-release ]; then cat /etc/lsb-release >> "#{output_file}"; fi
if [ -f /etc/redhat-release ]; then cat /etc/redhat-release >> "#{output_file}"; fi
if [ -f /etc/issue ]; then cat /etc/issue >> "#{output_file}"; fi
if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then cat /etc/os-release >> "#{output_file}"; fi
uptime >> "#{output_file}"
cat "#{output_file}" 2>/dev/null

output_file.description: Output file used to store the results.

mapping_evidence.note: Log source corrected from "audit" (auditd, not present on this endpoint) to "process_creation": snoopy execve telemetry surfaced by JISRSEC rule 100110, validated with wazuh-logtest. GET /rules?mitre=T1082 returned 6 rules, all Windows-only: none can match Linux uname/os-release reads.
